game.name: Estate Line
game.description: Estate Line is an invented property trading board game. Players move around a board of 44 spaces, buy streets, depots and works properties, build houses and hotels, and charge each other rent until one player is left.

extraGuidance: The symbol ₡ is the Crown, the money of Estate Line. Write amounts as ₡200 or as 200 Crowns. Never write a real-world currency symbol.

A property card prints its text in two boxes. `deed_text` holds the price, the district, and the mortgage value. `rent_text` holds every rent line and the building costs. Read both before you state what a property charges, and never conclude from `deed_text` alone that a card prints no rent.
Property cards carry no rarity, because Estate Line prints one copy of each deed. Do not report a rarity for them.

Property `stats` differ by property type. A street prints `rent_base` through `rent_with_hotel` plus `house_cost`. A depot prints `rent_one_depot` through `rent_four_depots` and no house cost. A works property prints `rent_multiplier_one_works` and `rent_multiplier_both_works`. Read the keys the card carries, and do not expect the keys of another type.

A playing token is the piece a player moves around the board. A token carries no rule and no rent. It prints only `description_text`, its material, and the edition that introduced it. Do not read a rule out of a token.
Estate Line has one rulebook, the Official Rules. Section 950 follows section 900, and both are current.
